name: browser-use
headline: Baoyu Comic AI Automation Skill
short_description: Automates repetitive tasks in operations using Claude Code. Improves efficiency for operations teams. Integrates with Node.js environments and supports TypeScript.
author: jimliu

sections.overview:
Baoyu-comic is an AI skill that automates the creation of comic-style visual content for Claude Code and similar AI agent environments. It supports multiple style options including chalkboard style, enabling flexible layout and design customization. The skill integrates seamlessly with Node.js environments and TypeScript, allowing developers and content teams to generate visual content programmatically. Use it to streamline content creation workflows, reduce manual design effort, and maintain consistent visual styling across projects. This tool is particularly useful for teams automating repetitive creative tasks.
Generate comic strips from blog posts to enhance reader engagement.
Create educational comics that simplify complex topics for students.
Transform user stories into comic formats for better visualization in presentations.
Automate the production of marketing comics to promote products on social media.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/jimliu/baoyu-skills`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
